text:
A certain ascetic, born free from the entanglements of the world, ever self-directed in his actions,
steadfast on the path of renunciation, indifferent to gain and loss,
adorned with a garland of flowers, his body smeared with ashes, clad in worn-out garments,
having attained a seat of a matted hair, free from ostentation, devoid of ego,
his mind fixed on the single desire of peace and bliss.
